name: Chain Proxy Support
description: Visually configure chain proxies and generate configurations with chain proxies.

name: One-Click Add Rule Sets
description: One-click add all rule sets to your list. After adding, you need to manually update the rule sets to download them locally so they can be referenced in your configuration files.

name: Scan QR Code to Share Configuration to Mobile CMFA
description: Mobile CMFA (Clash Meta for Android) scans the QR code to import the complete Mihomo configuration in one click. The PC starts a temporary local HTTP service to automatically adapt the mobile device: conditionally inherit TUN mode (completed only when enabled on PC, otherwise not interfered with), inline proxy-providers to eliminate naming conflicts (downgrade to http or error on failure), convert local rule-providers to remote HTTP and finally validate, complete GLOBAL proxy group to ensure CMFA visibility, intelligent DNS adaptation (ensure proxy-server-nameserver does not loop when DNS is enabled, complete all bootstrap fields when TUN is enabled). Supports chain proxy (dialer-proxy), custom proxy groups, and full configuration transmission. Supported by: KkemChen
